title: Generative AI and Power Imbalances in Global Education: Frameworks for Bias Mitigation
reasoning: The paper focuses on the ethics of digital neocolonialism and power imbalances, specifically evaluating AI through the lens of non-Western epistemologies and cultural imperialism. It moves beyond a simple 'ethical considerations' section by proposing a framework for 'Inclusive AI Design' based on international ethical instruments like UNESCO’s Recommendation on Ethics of Artificial Intelligence.
